Is a single world government inevitable for humans?
Humans are not inevitable. Neither is a government, nor a single world for humans.

Then the positive would be a shared sense of purpose for a time. The negative would be that it could not last long and would create great suffering and cruelty as those with the most authority try to hold the artificial system together. A federal model with division of labor between local, regional, national, and international authority requires both a common identity and a willingness of high level authorities to submit to the will of those below them in authority. To do otherwise requires an ever increasing level of control complexity. For each level of increasing control complexity there is a consequent loss of system reliability. The loss in reliability requires redundant systems be put in place. The redundant systems increases the complexity of the overall system, which results in further loss of reliability. There is a diminishing return on control for artificial networks, as ever increasing amounts of complexity expenditure must be used to maintain an ever diminishing returns on reliability. Meanwhile, as the systems of control are increased, the level of cruelty imposed on people in the system also increases- until a tipping point is eventually reached and they destroy the control systems and the entire network collapses to a state of maximum reliability and minimum complexity- essentially this is family and tribal units.

This is a complex but no less great answer. It would probably take a covert network of players several generations to bring a system like this about. It's almost like it would take the ruination of our currently held power structures for people to accept world control, and then the door is open for far greater corruption and greed which can only lead to suffering. It's not a pretty picture, but it's probably not far off from the truth.

One thing most people aren't considering here is that we're headed towards imminently becoming an interplanetary species. It will very likely happen in our life times that the first human is born on another planet. That is going to radically change the scale of our species. These colonies will undoubtedly be be multinational and so that brings up the question of who decides the laws and regulations.
